svg.aria-label: How an end-to-end scenario holds the loops once, then previews, advances, and measures each transition
svg.text: Once, at the start of the scenario
Hold every loop the scenario depends on
one pause holds the storefront's loops at their
gates, and the provisioner's convergence and lease
watchdogs are paused likewise; trading stays open
a registered host, a mock lane's gates, funding;
each recorded in the shared deal state
For each transition of the deal, in stage order
the route's evaluate twin or the
assert it is the move expected
the real route, one run-cycle or
mock gate: the work a timer would
by the stages that depend on it
the fixture's finaliser resumes every held loop,
so a failed stage leaves nothing held
after the last stage, or a failed one
